name: agentguards-copilot-selfhosted
description: LLM security guardrails for GitHub Copilot CLI, for a self-hosted AgentGuards appliance — jailbreak detection, prompt-injection and web-content scanning, data-exfiltration blocking, and destructive-command authorization, enforced entirely by hooks. No bundled MCP server: Copilot's .mcp.json cannot point at a per-installation URL, so a shared one would silently talk to AgentGuards' SaaS instead of your appliance. Use agentguards-copilot instead if you're on the hosted product.
